big_picture.title: Stock Market Falls As Jensen Huang Exits Nvidia; Small Caps Dive But These Groups Hold Up
big_picture.excerpt: The stock market, including the Dow Jones index, fell as Jensen Huang quit Nvidia amid multiple affairs. Small caps, biotechs were crushed.
paragraphs: The stock market saw an attempt to end the day in positive territory fall short after Nvidia (NVDA) Chief Executive Jensen Huang fell on his sword. Biotech and defense stocks were particular laggards.

The Nasdaq composite ended well off its session lows as it dropped 0.4%. The tech-heavy index found bullish support at its 200-day moving average, an encouraging sign. It also retains a gain for the week of more than 3% despite falling in two of the past three sessions.
